title: Transaction
description: The payment ledger. One object for each provider event that moved money. Added to, never changed or deleted.
formgrid:
id orderId
provider providerRef
type status
amount currency
providerEventId actor
summary summary
created .

type.label: Type
type.help: checkout_created, payment, payment_failed, payment_accepted, refund, dispute or dispute_closed.

amount.label: Amount
amount.help: In minor units. Always positive; the type says which way the money moved.

currency.label: Currency
currency.help: The three-letter code the amount is in.

providerRef.label: Provider Reference
providerRef.help: The payment, refund or dispute id at the provider.

providerEventId.label: Provider Event
providerEventId.help: The provider's id for the event, so one event is recorded once.

actor.label: Actor
actor.help: webhook:{provider}, or user:{collection}/{id} for a refund made by staff.

summary.label: Summary
summary.help: A small normalized part of the provider's event. Never card data, never the whole raw body.
